scope: Root adjudication of a place-versus-person certainty claim; raw draft unchanged.
primaryRead: Fixed WEB 1CH2:49 says Sheva father of Machbena in a passage also using father of known towns. Syntax alone does not settle literal offspring versus town founder/clan association.

secondaryOriginalRead.author: Albert Barnes, Notes on the Bible
secondaryOriginalRead.paraphrase: Barnes interprets Madmannah, Machbenah, Gibea and several following names as places and their fathers as associated chiefs. This is a historical interpretation, not conclusive archaeological identification.

otherEvidence: Author and independent reviewer cite a Wikipedia shared entry treating Machbena as a son/man. These interpretations differ.
decision: hold-with-interpretive-uncertainty; do not present definite person/not-place conclusion
requiredRepair: Replace categorical person exclusion reason with unresolved interpretation and retain cited competing source; no invented place profile or map point.
